title: Serve without making yourself the headline
summary: Service becomes pure when the self stops asking to be noticed. Keep service hidden enough for Naam to stay central.
takeaway: Keep service hidden enough for Naam to stay central.
lifeApplication: Before displaying the good you did, let the act remain quiet and return the heart to Naam.
